title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Submitting for Review the Cases of Defendants Who Were Sentenced to Death upon Retrial under the Trial Supervision Procedure and Who Committed Intentional Crimes during the Probation Period of a Death Sentence with Reprieve, Where Execution Should Be Carried Out
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Submitting for Review Cases Where a Defendant Sentenced to Death with a Two-Year Reprieve under the Trial Supervision Procedure Commits an Intentional Crime during the Probation Period and Should Be Executed

Fa [2003] No. 177

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, and the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army:

In accordance with the provisions of Article 206 and Article 200 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and Article 50 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, henceforth, in any death penalty review case where a defendant is sentenced to death under the trial supervision procedure, and the defendant has committed an intentional crime during the probation period for a death sentence with a two-year reprieve and should be executed, the case shall be uniformly submitted to the Supreme People's Court for approval.

November 26, 2003
